【原视频简介】
Why does water damage Endermen? Where do Ender Pearls actually come from? And why is there an empty void in the End dimension?

Join me as we dive deep into the End and its ocean-like elements. We'll explore a document that reveals the Endermen's true mission, what Shulkers actually are, and uncover how the End Dimension was once filled with water.

Join My Discord Server: https://discord.gg/uDj8vNaCpP

Become a Member Access Perks: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC9aJ-FXIdQAhFm2H2RO4pmw/join

I spend way too much time looking for the weirdest secrets in Minecraft so you don't have to. If you enjoy my content, commentary, or even me, please subscribe and smash like.
